title: Algerian Zesty Pastry Puffs
description: A crispy, flavorful pastry filled with zesty goodness. Perfect as a snack or dessert.
instructions: Roll out puff pastry to 1/4 inch thickness.
Cut into desired shapes (e.g., squares, circles).
Place pastry shapes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Mix Algerian Zesty Filling with a spoon or spatula, if using store-bought.
Place a spoonful of zesty filling in the center of each pastry shape.
Brush edges with beaten egg for a golden glaze.
Fold pastry in half to enclose filling and press edges to seal.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
